readings: Join transactionrecord to trader on an exact text match of trdref = tradereg, dropping unmatched transaction records. Count the matched transaction records in each tradekind group, including a separate group for NULL tradekind. Compute the arithmetic mean of those per-group counts. Return only groups whose count is strictly above that mean, showing tradekind, the transaction-record count, that count divided by the sum of all per-group counts, and the count minus the mean. Do not round; return no rows if the mean is missing.

Join transactionrecord to trader on an exact text match of trdref = tradereg, dropping unmatched transaction records. Count distinct matched traders in each tradekind group, so a trader with multiple transaction records counts once; include a separate group for NULL tradekind. Compute the arithmetic mean of those per-group counts. Return only groups whose count is strictly above that mean, showing tradekind, the distinct-trader count, that count divided by the sum of all per-group counts, and the count minus the mean. Do not round; return no rows if the mean is missing.
queries:
WITH group_counts AS (
    SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM transactionrecord AS tr
    INNER JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
totals AS (
    SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS mean_count,
           SUM(transaction_count) AS total_count
    FROM group_counts
)
SELECT g.tradekind,
       g.transaction_count,
       CAST(g.transaction_count AS REAL) / totals.total_count AS count_share,
       g.transaction_count - totals.mean_count AS count_above_mean
FROM group_counts AS g
CROSS JOIN totals
WHERE g.transaction_count > totals.mean_count

WITH group_counts AS (
    SELECT trader.tradekind,
           COUNT(DISTINCT trader.tradereg) AS trader_count
    FROM transactionrecord
    JOIN trader
      ON transactionrecord.trdref = trader.tradereg COLLATE BINARY
    GROUP BY trader.tradekind
),
totals AS (
    SELECT AVG(trader_count) AS mean_count,
           SUM(trader_count) AS total_count
    FROM group_counts
)
SELECT group_counts.tradekind,
       group_counts.trader_count,
       1.0 * group_counts.trader_count / totals.total_count AS share,
       group_counts.trader_count - totals.mean_count AS above_mean
FROM group_counts
CROSS JOIN totals
WHERE group_counts.trader_count > totals.mean_count
